name: Youth Advisory Commission
what_you_do: Advise the City Council on issues that matter to youth. You also plan activities that build good youth relations in La Mesa.
who_can_apply: Ages 13 to 20 when you are appointed. You must live in La Mesa or go to school there. A class like karate or ballet does not count as school.
duration: 2 year term. This open seat ends Sept 30, 2027.
deadline_text: A notice posted Oct 14, 2026 lists one alternate seat, open until filled. The yearly recruitment is in September and October.
how_to_apply: Fill out the city application. Email it to cityclrk@cityoflamesa.gov or bring it to City Hall, 8130 Allison Avenue. You then interview with the City Council.
notes: An alternate goes to meetings and votes only when a member is away. Meetings are the second Monday of the month at 4:30 PM at the Community Center. Questions: Isabel Armenta, 619-667-1307.
